Backend Engineer, Payments Platform
Northwind Technologies — Bengaluru (Hybrid)

About the role
Our Payments Platform team owns the services that move money for 40 million
customers. You will work on the ledger, the reconciliation pipeline, and the
public payouts API.

What you will do
- Design, build and operate Python services behind a high-traffic public API
- Own reconciliation jobs end to end, from schema design to on-call
- Partner with risk and compliance teams to ship auditable changes

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional backend engineering experience
- Strong Python; you can reason about the standard library without reaching for
  a search engine
- Production experience with PostgreSQL, including query plans and indexing
- Experience building and consuming REST APIs at scale
- Comfortable with Docker and a CI/CD pipeline
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
- Exposure to Kubernetes in production
- Familiarity with payments, ledgers or double-entry accounting
- Experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
- Prior on-call ownership of a Tier-1 service

We are an equal opportunity employer.
